name: com.gamecore.unity.app
description: SADR-010 application root of a GameCore game: composes the catalog manifest source, the composition lane with its validate-before-commit preflight, the target registry, recipes, migrations, ownership/stage descriptor, assembly publisher, derived-assembly pipeline, world/composition bridge, provenance explanation reader, observation hub and the world's adapter-frame registration with a one-pump counter, from one GameApplicationDefinition. Boots through the MonoBehaviour-free GameApplication.Boot(definition) or, on the player path, through the single application bootstrap in hard-failure mode; a boot either produces the game's world or a typed GameApplicationBootFailed.
